GeM Bid Document (DEMO - not a real tender)
Bid Number: GEM/2026/B/0000001
Ministry/State Name: Demo State Public Works Department
Item Category: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of LT Electrical Works for Office Building
Bid End Date/Time: 15-11-2026 15:00:00
Estimated Bid Value: 18,50,000

Bid Details
Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years): 25 Lakh(s)
Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service: 3 Year(s)
MSE Exemption for Years Of Experience and Turnover: No
EMD Detail
Required: Yes
EMD Amount: 37,000
MSE exemption from EMD: No
Bidders shall upload documentary evidence for turnover and experience along with the bid.

Additional Terms and Conditions
1. The bidder shall submit Manufacturer's Authorization Form (MAF) from Schneider Electric for all MCCBs offered, specific to this bid.
2. The bidder must possess a valid ISO 9001 certificate on the date of bid submission.
3. The bidder must hold a valid electrical contractor licence issued by the State Licensing Board.
4. Material shall be delivered within 30 days of award of contract.

List of Approved Makes
MCB / RCCB / Distribution Boards: Havells, Legrand, Schneider
MCCB: Schneider, ABB, L&T
Cables and Wires: Polycab, Havells, KEI
LED Light Fittings: Philips, Havells, Wipro
Any make not listed above shall be rejected.
